description:
The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is already loaded in InVesalius. Visualize the internal bone structure of the skull (cranial diploë and sinuses) by creating a 3D surface and applying a sagittal cut.

Steps:
1. Create a mask using the standard Bone threshold.
2. Generate a 3D surface from the mask.
3. Use the 'Cut Plane' (or Clipping Plane) tool to slice the 3D model sagittally (removing one half).
4. Position the view to clearly show the cross-section of the bone.
5. Export a screenshot of this view to '/home/ga/Documents/skull_cross_section.png'.
